title: Approval-aware exact candidate validation, main-wide source pinning, and source-pinned convergence

phases.objective: Keep governed release and validation surfaces open while Exact Candidate Validation waits for its required approval, and reject any retry whose live main no longer equals the authorized request pin.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A source-pinned candidate has an open release PR and validation PR, while exact candidate CI is completed with action_required.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The launcher keeps bounded polling and both governed review surfaces open until approval produces a successful exact validation, a non-approval failure occurs, or the bounded deadline expires; it never treats action_required as an immediate stale-candidate failure.
steps: Build the candidate and verify the release branch and validation branch point to the exact candidate SHA.
Resolve the exact candidate validation run by the candidate SHA and bounded attempt window.
Dispatch each non-Spec-011 supporting gate exactly once on the release branch when no exact-candidate run is already visible, then resolve it by the candidate SHA.
When the run is action_required, retain the release and validation PRs and continue bounded polling for the required approval.
After approval, require exact validation success and continue the supporting gates and final protected-ref readbacks.
If the approval deadline expires or the run fails for a non-approval conclusion, close the governed surfaces with an explicit fail-closed reason.
assertions: action_required is an approval-pending state, not an immediate validation failure.
Supporting gates are dispatched only on the exact release branch and accepted only when their head SHA equals the candidate SHA.
No fake approval, review bypass, dummy commit, Production merge, deployment, migration, provider call, credential read, Cloudflare change, or external write is performed.
The review surfaces remain available for the authorized human approval while the bounded wait is active.
Exact candidate evidence remains required before convergence can be marked successful.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A new commit is pushed to main while a governed launcher run or release candidate is pinned to an older main SHA.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The guard reads the current exact main SHA, cancels only outdated governed promotion runs, marks only stale governed release PRs with auditable evidence, and leaves ordinary development branches and unrelated PRs untouched. A required read-only Production source-pin gate then prevents any stale release surface from becoming merge-eligible.
steps: Read back the current main ref and require the workflow event to be a main push or an explicitly pinned guard dispatch.
List only in-progress governed promotion and candidate-validation runs bound to obsolete source pins, parse API JSON through jq outside the GitHub CLI, and cancel those runs.
Inspect only governed release PRs targeting Production through the immutable promotion marker, extract their pinned main SHA, and mark only stale candidates without closing them automatically.
Require the read-only Production source-pin gate to compare the release pin and candidate tree against the live main and Production refs before merge eligibility.
Publish a structured evidence artifact that records canceled runs and marked stale release PRs without secrets or external provider/database mutations.
Require the next promotion request to build a new exact candidate and re-run workflow-dispatch Exact Candidate Validation from the current main pin.
assertions: The guard runs automatically on every push to main.
Run-selection filters pass dynamic values to jq through a JSON pipe rather than unsupported gh api jq argument flags.
The guard never closes ordinary development PRs, touches Spec 015, merges Production, deploys, runs migrations, grants privileges, reads credential payloads, or calls providers.
A candidate with a stale main or Production pin cannot pass the required source-pin gate and therefore cannot remain an eligible governed release surface.

phases.objective: Observe approval-aware convergence on a stable exact-main pin and publish the resulting candidate evidence without changing protected refs.
Exercise delayed approval, canceled validation, API readback errors, and concurrent main movement while proving the launcher stays bounded and fail-closed.
This orchestration repair has no provider or live-runtime canary authority.
This repair does not authorize Production merge, deployment, database mutation, migration, provider calls, or Cloudflare changes.
